doc.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002

title: Subbing for Elvin with Tyree Glenn, Harry Edison and on a record date
summary: Elvin sends him on subs with Tyree Glenn and Edison-Forrest and a session with an unknown singer.

bands.name: Harry Edison and Jimmy Forrest Quintet

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: He sent me — I think the first sub he sent me on was with Tyree Glenn’s quartet. And Tyree had like a sort of happy hour gig at The Round Table on 50th Street and Third Avenue, which was a pretty popular restaurant at the time. It had medieval décor and his quartet was Tommy Flanagan, Tommy Potter and Elvin. And they used to do remotes on Kate Smith’s afternoon show which came on I think at four o’clock, which was like the precursor of Mike Douglas’ show. In fact I think that was from Philly too. And she’d feature Tyree periodically on her show doing a remote from The Round Table. But anyway Elvin sent me on that and then he sent me to sub with Harry Edison and Jimmy Forrest’s quintet, which had the same rhythm section, Tommy Flanagan, Tommy Potter and Elvin. And I subbed for Elvin a couple of times with that band. And he sent me on a couple of record dates. One was with a woman who sang and whistled. She was sort of like a folk singer, I don’t know if anybody’s — well I’ll have to ask Elvin if he remembers who she was. I think he’s the only one who is alive who — Dick Katz — well no, the pianist was Jimmy Jones, the bassist was George Duvivier, and it was just a four piece rhythm section. The guitarist was Barry Galbraith and the drummer was supposed to be Elvin. But he sent me. And we did the date. I remember she sang I guess blues and whistled a couple of choruses. I never did find out who she was.
I can’t ask Tommy, he’s gone, I can’t ask either one of the Tommys, they’re both gone. Elvin I think is the only one who I can ask. George Duvivier is gone.
